sections.advice: back through Cueva de las Conchas → Cueva de las Cabras is 32 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-cueva-de-las-cabras-rio-frio.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cueva-de-las-cabras-rio-frio.story: 278 km from Calasparra to Calasparra, about 4 h 48 of riding. On the way it passes Cueva de las Conchas, Cueva de los Cascarones, Abrigo de la Rambla de Pedro Izquierdo and Río frío. The highest point is about 1,450 m. The line favours views over speed.

nz-takaka-hill-and-golden-bay.slogan: Takaka Hill and Golden Bay – 62 km between Nelson and Takaka
nz-takaka-hill-and-golden-bay.story: Sustained elevation change, linked bends and open summit views. It also links naturally to Te Waikoropupu and Golden Bay.

legend-paso-de-los-libertadores.story: A high mountain crossing from Santiago, Chile to Mendoza, Argentina, via Los Andes. Key character: Andes; switchbacks; high-altitude views. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Paso de los Libertadores
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is Paso de los Libertadores, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
